Application Process How to Apply FAQ Know Before You Join What programs and technologies are included in the curriculum? ​ The School of the Future offers interdisciplinary programs that seamlessly integrate technology, science, and creativity. The curriculum features specialized majors in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Blockchain, and Biotechnology with AI, alongside innovative programs in Design, Digital Humanities, and Business Analytics. Each program combines academic rigor with hands-on laboratories, industry-led projects, and global technology partnerships, ensuring students graduate with practical expertise and the agility to thrive in tomorrow’s evolving digital landscape. How are emerging technologies integrated into learning? Technology is woven into every aspect of our teaching. We partner with industry leaders (e.g. Google, IBM) so students earn certifications in AI, cloud computing and data science as part of their studies. Our campus is a “tech-enabled” learning lab – with maker spaces, innovation centers and labs – where students experiment with robotics, IoT, AI and sustainable systems in real projects. In this hands-on approach, theory is always paired with practical application, reflecting how enterprises use emerging tech. What career paths can graduates pursue? Graduates step into dynamic careers across frontline industries, shaping the future of technology and innovation. From AI and machine learning to big data, cloud computing, and cybersecurity, they are equipped to excel in high-impact roles. Many pursue careers in design thinking, digital transformation, and product innovation, while others channel their entrepreneurial drive to launch successful startups. At TIU’s School of the Future, students don’t just prepare for today’s job market—they gain the vision, resilience, and leadership to thrive in global enterprises and pioneer solutions for tomorrow’s challenges. What are the eligibility criteria and admission requirements? TIU welcomes aspiring students who meet the university’s academic and entrance standards. For undergraduate programs, applicants must hold a Class 12 qualification—typically in the science stream for engineering or design—and secure valid scores in recognized entrance exams such as WBJEE or JEE Main. Postgraduate applicants may be required to qualify through exams like GATE or CAT, depending on their chosen discipline. Admissions can be completed online or through TIU’s central office, with candidates submitting academic records and test results. TIU is accredited by UGC and AICTE, and accepts scores from WBJEE, JEE, CAT, GATE, and other approved examinations. How is the teaching and learning approach structured? The teaching model at TIU is designed to align education with industry needs and future opportunities. Through research-driven coursework, experiential projects, and global exposure, students gain both depth and breadth of knowledge. Interactive learning environments, coupled with mentorship, ensure graduates emerge with the critical thinking, leadership, and adaptability required to excel in dynamic industries. title: FAQ | Techno India University
content_preview: top of page Menu Close Home About Us Contact Admissions Approvals FAQ Google and IBM Courses FAQ Know Before You Join What programs and technologies are included in the curriculum? ​ The School of the Future offers interdisciplinary programs that seamlessly integrate technology, science, and creativity. The curriculum features specialized majors in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Blockchain, and Biotechnology with AI, alongside innovative programs in Design
full_content: top of page Menu Close Home About Us Contact Admissions Approvals FAQ Google and IBM Courses FAQ Know Before You Join What programs and technologies are included in the curriculum? ​ The School of the Future offers interdisciplinary programs that seamlessly integrate technology, science, and creativity. The curriculum features specialized majors in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Blockchain, and Biotechnology with AI, alongside innovative programs in Design, Digital Humanities, and Business Analytics. Each program combines academic rigor with hands-on laboratories, industry-led projects, and global technology partnerships, ensuring students graduate with practical expertise and the agility to thrive in tomorrow’s evolving digital landscape. How are emerging technologies integrated into learning? Technology is woven into every aspect of our teaching. We partner with industry leaders (e.g. Google, IBM) so students earn certifications in AI, cloud computing and data science as part of their studies. Our campus is a “tech-enabled” learning lab – with maker spaces, innovation centers and labs – where students experiment with robotics, IoT, AI and sustainable systems in real projects. In this hands-on approach, theory is always paired with practical application, reflecting how enterprises use emerging tech. What career paths can graduates pursue? Graduates step into dynamic careers across frontline industries, shaping the future of technology and innovation. From AI and machine learning to big data, cloud computing, and cybersecurity, they are equipped to excel in high-impact roles. Many pursue careers in design thinking, digital transformation, and product innovation, while others channel their entrepreneurial drive to launch successful startups. At TIU’s School of the Future, students don’t just prepare for today’s job market—they gain the vision, resilience, and leadership to thrive in global enterprises and pioneer solutions for tomorrow’s challenges. What are the eligibility criteria and admission requirements? TIU welcomes aspiring students who meet the university’s academic and entrance standards. For undergraduate programs, applicants must hold a Class 12 qualification—typically in the science stream for engineering or design—and secure valid scores in recognized entrance exams such as WBJEE or JEE Main. Postgraduate applicants may be required to qualify through exams like GATE or CAT, depending on their chosen discipline. Admissions can be completed online or through TIU’s central office, with candidates submitting academic records and test results. TIU is accredited by UGC and AICTE, and accepts scores from WBJEE, JEE, CAT, GATE, and other approved examinations. How is the teaching and learning approach structured? The teaching model at TIU is designed to align education with industry needs and future opportunities. Through research-driven coursework, experiential projects, and global exposure, students gain both depth and breadth of knowledge. Interactive learning environments, coupled with mentorship, ensure graduates emerge with the critical thinking, leadership, and adaptability required to excel in dynamic industries. © 2025 Techno India University Website Created By : FRIX Studio Home About Us Contact Admissions Approvals FAQ Google and IBM Courses bottom of page
